title: aliciella humillima
intro: Aliciella humillima, commonly known as the 'low' or 'small' Aliciella, is a species of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. Aliciella humillima is also believed to have therapeutic actions, such as modulating the immune system and exhibiting antimicrobial activities, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects. The bioactive constituents of Aliciella humillima include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
